title: Ornate Santa's Sleigh
description: A highly detailed, ornate wooden sleigh with red runners and golden trim floats in a starry night sky. It features large glowing reindeer antlers adorned with blue bells and mistletoe, a green velvet blanket with purple fur trim, and casts a large dark shadow on the purple ground below.
prompt: A highly detailed ornate wooden Santa's sleigh with red runners and intricate golden decorations floating in a dark starry night sky. The sleigh has large glowing reindeer antlers decorated with hanging blue bells and mistletoe, a green velvet blanket with purple fur trim draped over the seat, and snowflake motifs. The sleigh casts a large dramatic shadow on the misty purple ground below, magical festive atmosphere, digital painting style.
